description: Express.js route definitions for session management, including tenant listing and selection, with audit logging and RBAC validation.

methods.name: GET /tenants
methods.description: Lists authorized tenants for the current user, with audit logging.

methods.name: POST /tenant
methods.description: Sets the active tenant for the session, with RBAC validation, cookie setting, and audit logging.

methods.name: POST /tenants/select
methods.description: Alias route to select active tenant, reusing the /tenant handler.
